d:
A few days ago, I had the opportunity to meet Ramarao Madhavan (R Madhavan). He is a Tamil Kayastha, but inspired by Netaji, he dropped his caste-based title from his name.
His full name is Ramarao Madhavan Pillai, born in 1925 in Rangoon (Yangon). His father, Ramarao, was a trader there. In 1942, when Rash Behari Bose laid the foundation of the Indian Independence League in Southeast Asian countries, Ramarao Madhavan also became a part of it.
